Phase-15.NAME: ReleaseVerification
Phase-15.purpose: Verify v0.1.0 release readiness before publication.

steps.step-1: Run installer dry-run and installer unit tests.
steps.step-2: Run release surface tests for GitHub URLs, version, and install docs.
steps.step-3: Run MyGRACE lint, lint, typecheck, and build.
steps.step-5: Run npm pack dry-run and record the v0.1.0 package preview.
